verdict.rationale: Name.com documents webhook subscriptions for domain and account events, an auto-renew setting, and email forwarding rules. None of these is a user-definable rules engine that triggers actions automatically on events. Webhooks only deliver notifications for a developer to build their own handling logic, which makes them a building block. Auto-renew and email forwarding are adjacent features, not event-triggered rule definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
